settings.heading: A Resume Built Around What You've Actually Achieved
settings.content: Most resumes list job duties. Ours are built around outcomes — the specific, measurable results that show a hiring manager exactly what you're capable of. Every resume we write is structured for two readers at once: the applicant tracking system that scans it first, and the human recruiter who decides what happens next.

settings.heading: The Right Resume for Where You Are
settings.subheading: Every resume type below is available across our packages — the format is matched to your career stage and target role.

settings.title: Professional Resume
settings.text: A clean, achievement-based resume for mid-level professionals — the foundation of every package.

settings.title: ATS Resume
settings.text: Formatted specifically to parse cleanly through applicant tracking systems, with keyword alignment to your target job postings.

settings.title: Modern Resume
settings.text: A contemporary layout with clear visual hierarchy — professional, not flashy, and still fully ATS-safe.

settings.title: Executive Resume
settings.text: Built for director-level and above: leadership impact, P&L ownership, and strategic results, not task lists.

settings.title: Keyword-Optimized Resume
settings.text: Keywords are pulled from real job descriptions in your target field so your resume speaks the language recruiters search for.

settings.title: Interview-Focused Resume
settings.text: Structured so every bullet point gives you a natural, confident talking point once you reach the interview stage.

settings.heading: Benefits of a Professionally Written Resume
settings.text:
• Pass automated screening instead of being filtered out before a human sees your application
  • Communicate your value in the first 6-10 seconds a recruiter spends scanning
  • Present consistent, error-free formatting across every application you submit
  • Reuse a strong foundation across multiple tailored versions for different roles

settings.heading: How Your Resume Gets Written
settings.subheading: From purchase to final file, here's exactly what happens.

settings.title: Purchase Your Package
settings.text: Choose the resume package that matches your career stage — from Entry-Level Graduate to Executive.

settings.title: Share Your Background
settings.text: Send your current resume (if you have one), your target job title, and 1-2 example job postings.

settings.title: First Draft
settings.text: Your writer delivers a complete first draft within your package's stated business-day window.

settings.title: Revisions
settings.text: Request changes within your included revision rounds until the resume is exactly right.

settings.title: Final Delivery
settings.text: Receive your finished resume as an editable Word file and a polished PDF.

settings.heading: Questions About Our Resume Writing Service

settings.question: What's the difference between the Professional Resume and Executive Career packages?
settings.answer: The Professional Resume package covers a full achievement-based rewrite for most career stages. The Executive Career Package adds executive-level positioning, a career consultation call, and unlimited revisions for senior leadership roles.

settings.question: Do you write resumes for career changers?
settings.answer: Yes. We highlight transferable skills and reframe prior experience around your new target role rather than simply listing your past job titles.

settings.question: Can you work from an existing resume instead of starting from scratch?
settings.answer: Yes — send your current resume and we'll rebuild it, or use the Starter Career Package if you only need an ATS review and optimization rather than a full rewrite.

settings.question: How many revisions do I get?
settings.answer: Revisions range from 1 round on entry-level packages to unlimited revisions for 30 days on our Executive and Ultimate packages. See each package for exact details.

settings.heading: Ready for a Resume That Works as Hard as You Do?
settings.text: Choose a resume package and get a professionally written, ATS-optimized resume in as little as 2 business days.
